accepted_implementation_fixes: Upload and idempotent replay enforce the stored attempt restaurant/menu/experiment/variant/surface tuple.
Behavioral and gold target classes are separate.
Native cancellation and additional failure stages exist.
Terminal review updates occur in one database function.
blocking_findings: Terminal comparison creation uses a weaker Management predicate than the exported gold contract and does not prove distinct nonduplicate images.
Rejected reviews can be rerun into approval, so the terminal transition is not one-shot.
Review can backfill a missing stored rights scope.
Contradictory outcomes can coexist for one attempt/event/source.
Existing attempt reuse does not compare every stored binding field in createContributionAttempt.
Traffic classification is insufficient for a verified non-team denominator.
The orderability label is stronger than the missing-streak evidence.
The sample omits dish labels and source-page evidence, blocking exact item and provenance audit.
The six-row selection delta lacks a same-snapshot reconciliation ledger.
Zero attempts and receipts leave the runtime state machine unexercised.
